September reconciles: all 12 finalized invoices (`inv_2026_09_001` to `012`) are in the ledger export.

Your exact command, `--month 2026-09`, reported all 12 invoices missing and exited 1. The cause is the script's default `--format v2`, which expects `entry_id` in the first column. The September export (`var/ledger/2026-09.csv`) has the invoice ref first, which is the v1 layout. With `--format v1` it reports all 12 present and exits 0.

The script only checks that each invoice ref appears. It doesn't compare amounts. The invoice list is also hardcoded in the script as `inv_2026_09_001` to `012`, not read from the billing data. So it can't catch an invoice that's missing from that list.

I didn't change the script. If you'd like, I can make it detect the format from the header row, or change the default to v1. The file's header is `col1,col2,col3`, so detection would have to go by column contents instead.
